questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Open-cast mining carries severe occupational hazards of toxic gas asphyxiation and roof collapse.
Statement II: Shaft mining requires specialized vertical lifts, haulage vehicles, and air ventilation systems.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Statement I is false: toxic gases, flooding, and roof collapse are hazards of deep shaft (underground) mining, not open-cast mining. Statement II is correct: shaft mining requires elaborate vertical lifts and ventilation.
Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.
